application_credentials.description: Create a Site Access application in the SolarEdge Developer Console ({developer_console_url}). Enable the SITE_DATA and DEVICE_DATA scopes and register this exact redirect URI: {redirect_url}. Upload solaredge_callback.html to that path on your website. Copy the client ID and client secret into Home Assistant.
